ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Environmental Hazards Kit
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
ALPHA_MECHANICS_KIT_1. Six generalized, XML-configurable environmental mechanics the base game cannot do, each a reusable comp/worker/extension rather than a def-specific hardcode. Design borrowed by function from the Alpha-family source review (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/alpha_family_source_review.md, section 4, owner ruling 2026-09-11) — no donor code or art ships here; every class below was written against vanilla's own API and vanilla's own equivalents.
RM tier: nothing in this mod knows what campaign, planet or creature it is used by. A content def in any mod opts in through XML alone.
1. CompProperties_ActiveGasEmitter — a ThingComp that periodically seeds a configurable gas ThingDef into a radius, optionally power-gated. Companions: Gas_Damaging (tick-and-scan damage/hediff/plant-damage gas, driven by GasDamageExtension) and Gas_Transmuting (tick-and-scan flora rewrite, driven by GasTransmuteExtension). Abstract XML parent RM_BaseGas ships in Defs/. 2. HediffCompProperties_PeriodicAreaAttack — a HediffComp (so it stacks onto ANY existing HediffDef via XML) that deals falloff-by-distance, per-ThingCategory scaled area damage around its carrier, with optional filth and sustainer. 3. BiomeGlowMultiplierExtension — a DefModExtension on any BiomeDef; one Harmony postfix on GenCelestial.CurCelestialSunGlow makes that biome permanently darker and vanilla's own darkness chain (accuracy, mood, plant growth) does the rest. Optionally also forces ConditionalStatAffecter_InSunlight to read false there. 4. GameCondition_EnvironmentalWeather — a data-driven weather-lock condition (EnvironmentalWeatherExtension on the GameConditionDef): forced weather, interval damage to unroofed pawns with a species gate, item-rot acceleration, plant-kill chance, animal/plant density factors, and flat or day/night temperature offsets. 5. DeathActionProperties_ScaledExplosion — one DeathActionWorker whose explosion radius is indexed by the dying pawn's life stage, with configurable damage, weapon-for-flash, sound and post-explosion filth. Paired with GameCondition_ArmLatentHazard, which periodically arms every matching pawn on the map with a configured HediffDef. 6. CompProperties_AbilityTargetedHediffAffliction — one ability effect comp that either adds N of a HediffDef to random body parts, or destroys every body part matching a BodyPartDef with a configured damage type.
Live proof is OWED: this mod has not yet been loaded in a running game.
